vibe: Rustic Tuscan meets Premium Dark Steakhouse. Emotional tone: Warm, appetizing, high-quality, authentic.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-stone-50
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-amber-500

components.buttons: Rounded-none or rounded-sm. bg-amber-600 text-stone-950 font-bold px-8 py-4 hover:bg-amber-500 transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest text-sm.
components.menu_item: Flex container with item name and price. Use border-b border-dashed border-stone-700/50 between name and price to mimic classic menus. Title in Playfair, description in Manrope.
components.dietary_tags: Small pill badges text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider. 1px solid border.
components.whatsapp_cta: Fixed bottom right button with high elevation shadow, or a prominent sticky header button. Use WhatsApp green (#25D366) or match the amber theme.

sections.name: Hero
sections.instructions: Full viewport height. Background image (hero_burger) with bg-stone-950/70 overlay to ensure text contrast. Align content to bottom-left for a cinematic feel. Massive Playfair Display heading.

sections.name: Menu Filters
sections.instructions: Sticky bar below hero. Horizontal scrollable list of categories (Hamburger, Ciabatte, Piadine, Griglia-Barbeque, Contorni) and dietary filter toggles.

sections.name: Menu Grid
sections.instructions: CSS Grid (1 col mobile, 2 cols desktop). Sections divided by rustic typography headers. Use image_urls.ciabatta and image_urls.grill_bbq as visual breaks or bento box features between menu categories.

sections.name: Contact & Hours
sections.instructions: Darker section (bg-stone-950). Large typography for 'Vieni a trovarci'. Include Address, Phone, Hours.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure fonts: 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope'.
Set the Tailwind config to use 'stone' colors as the primary grayscale to achieve the warm Tuscan dark theme.
Do NOT use pure white or pure black. Always tint.
Apply `dark_texture_bg` as a fixed background layer with low opacity (e.g., 5-10%) to give the whole site a rustic/blackboard feel without hindering readability.
Implement dietary filters (vegetariano, piccante, con pollo, con manzo) that actually filter the menu sections or dim non-matching items.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
